name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=chapter, descriptor=transition_menu. Accurately reflects the function's role as the between-chapter dispatch + intro/save menu (frees prior per-chapter state, rebuilds the portrait cache, then dispatches story vs battle chapter). No Ghidra address residue in the name; 'menu' is a semantic descriptor, not a hex suffix.
purpose: Between-chapter dispatch and intro/save menu: invoked from the main loop when a chapter transition is pending; frees per-chapter dynamic state, rebuilds the portrait cache, then runs either the story-chapter intro radio menu or the battle-chapter save-prompt + recruitment screen.
logic_summary: Phase 1: idempotent NULL-guarded free of runtime_char array, tile-event table, battle scene snapshot, battle tile map, and portrait cache. Phase 2: reopen FDICON.B24 and reload each menu-party member's portrait into the cache (count reset to 0). Phase 3: branch on data_fd2_chapter_per_chapter_category_table[current_chapter_id]. category==0 (STORY): malloc a 0x25680 scene buffer, fetch chapter-intro metadata, fade to black, set BGM 10, blit the FDOTHER intro panel (idx from a 3-byte lut indexed by category) into the scene buffer, load the FDOTHER[10] menu overlay, fade in, then run a do/while radio-option input loop -- a BIOS-tick-paced idle blink animation (frame 0..3) runs while no key is pending; left (0x4d) decrements / right (0x4b) increments the wrapped 0..4 cursor with SFX, 0xe0/0x52 are treated as Enter, F8 (0x22) cycles a debug BGM 0..9, and a metadata hotkey (scancode==meta[2] && cursor==meta[1]) jumps the cursor to 5; on Enter (0x1c) or Space it plays a commit SFX (unless cursor==2) and calls fd2_chapter_transition_with_intro, looping until that returns non-zero. Then frees the overlay; if cursor!=2 returns 1, else falls through to the shared 'return 0'. category!=0 (BATTLE): clear VGA, load portrait 0x4b, show the save-prompt dialog (text idx 0x19a) via the typewriter loop (battle_tile_map sentinel set to 1 then 0), tear it down, and if the user chose 'Yes' (dialog_result!=-1 && menu_cursor_idx==0) load FDOTHER[0xD], save to slot 0, free it; then run fd2_run_recruitment_or_branch_screen in a loop (splicing the menu roster into the runtime char ptr) until it returns non-zero, restore full palette, return 0.

returns.semantics: 1 = story-chapter intro committed without choosing 'save' (cursor != 2) -> caller continues normal flow; 0 = story-chapter 'save' chosen (cursor == 2) or battle-chapter branch completed. The story 'cursor != 2 -> return 1' early-out and the battle branch share the trailing 'return 0' (original's XOR EAX,EAX; JMP epilogue at 0x2CCFD).
